name: comfortable-video
description: Comfortable Video - 快適な動画視聴環境を提供するChrome拡張機能

scripts.build:ts: esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/content.js --target=chrome100 && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/background.js --target=chrome100 && esbuild src/options.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/options.js --target=chrome100
scripts.build:copy: rsync -a public/ dist/ || cp -r public/. dist/ || true
scripts.build: pnpm run build:scss && pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:copy
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
